    SELECT * FROM audioandmedia
    WHERE (1 - thdpct / 2) * (spksensedb / 100.0) * (1 - audlatms / 100.0) * 10 <= 8.0

    WHERE interactphysref IN (SELECT physregistry FROM dependent_physical)

), removed_physical AS (
    DELETE FROM physicaldurability
    WHERE physregistry IN (SELECT physregistry FROM dependent_physical)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM removed_interactions) >= 0
    RETURNING physregistry
), removed_rgb AS (
    DELETE FROM rgb
    WHERE rgbregistry IN (SELECT rgbregistry FROM dependent_rgb)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM removed_physical) >= 0
    RETURNING rgbregistry
)
DELETE FROM audioandmedia
WHERE audregistry IN (SELECT audregistry FROM poor_audio)

RETURNING *;
